author: Jiim
body:
Hey, My name is Jim and I'm a 13 year old lad from OCN.

I used to play on Avicus for a while when I got invited to Patchi, where I met a lot of people and where I carried as they said.
I didn't play Avicus ever since I left Patchi, and I'd like to get a bit more on the competitive side of Avicus

Bow (7/10)
Melee (7.5/10)
Communication (7.5/10)
cps (9-12)

I'm a rusher and also a decent cannoneer.
